Theorem
[Kennard's Euler-characteristic criterion]

Source: petersen:page-0343 ↗ def:pet-ch8-symmetry-rank 1. ch8:8.3.12If $M^{4n}$ is a compact $4n$-manifold with positive sectional curvature and symmetry rank $k>2\log _4(4n)-2$, then $\chi (M)>0$.
